title: The Propagating Contradiction of the Sign: The Closure of the Sign for Non-Presentation Under the Rules of Classical Notation, Exhibited in the Lorentz Decoration of the Folded Cone
content: The sign that classical notation reserves for a withheld count is a formed mark given the office of standing for a presentation that was withheld. Its formation certifies presentation and its office cancels it, and that pairing is the root-grammatical contradiction identified by the presence-only programme. This paper proves that the contradiction propagates. In a term calculus with the sign adjoined, the class of terms whose value is the sign is closed under multiplication by every term (the absorption law); a sum with such a term presents the other summand, the passage through the sign being recorded in the derivation while the value stays clean (the identity law); division by such a term is withheld, which the classical notation prints as its non-value word; the cancellation rule applied with its guard left off rewrites the withheld quotient of the sign by itself as the unit; and the guard itself is the sign negated. Each rule discharges an obligation of the sign by writing the sign again, and the identity law and the returned non-value are shown to be completions of a positive fragment, the free adjunction of a neutral element and the totalization of a partial evaluation, performed in the classical regime with the interface left unnamed. The exhibit is the phenomenological velocity of the folded cone. A disc with a sector removed folds into a cone whose height is written through the removed arc; in reduced coordinates the height relation reads \( P\sin\beta=\sqrt{L_+L_-} \) with \( L_\pm=P\pm Q \) the sum and the difference of the disc's circumference and the base's circumference, and the insertion of the Lorentz coefficient \( \kappa=\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2} \) together with its inverse, one factor under each radical, carries \( L_+ \) by \( \kappa \) and \( L_- \) by \( \kappa^{-1} \): a Lorentz boost of the pair \( (P,Q) \)written in light-cone form, with rapidity \( -\ln\kappa \), under which the product \( L_+L_-=P^2-Q^2 \), the square of the cone's height, is kept. The classical register reads the insertion as a factored unity \( \kappa\kappa^{-1} \), idle at the level of the product, and solves for the velocity by clearing with \( \kappa^2 \), which manufactures the balance \( (c^2-v^2)D\ \)= with \( D \) the coherence form of the cone, and by cancelling \( D \). We prove that the decorated relation states, at every act, that the height is the invariant of the boost, so that it is free of the velocity and leaves the act's ratio free on the coherence locus; that the acts below light compose, ratios multiplying and rapidities adding, into an ordered semigroup in which every member is refused the office of a neutral element, the structure of the positive tallies under fusion; that the velocity coordinate performs two completions on that semigroup, adjoining a neutral element at the origin, which the books read as rest, and giving the open end of the family a finite name, the border \( |v|=c \), which the books read as the light branch; that the clearing and the cancellation return that name as the solved velocity\( v=\pm\sqrt{c^2D}/\sqrt D \), which presents a value exactly off the locus, where the relation is refused, and is withheld exactly on the locus, where the relation holds, so that the contradiction the classical register finds in the derivation is produced by its own reading of the coordinate's two completions as members of the family; that the classical disjunction, \( D \) in balance or the velocity at the border, has one presented horn and one horn manufactured by the absorber, held as a record; that every classical reading of the formula on the locus, the returned non-value of partial-function semantics and of the wheels, the vacuous universal, and the absorbed quotient of the meadows, is a surrogate of the sign by the test; and that the whole of what the relation says about the velocity, the orientation mark of a product of two principal roots, is presented on the two regimes below and above light, constant on each, raised on both throughout the cone's wedge, which every boost preserves, and changing at the border in the wedges with a lowered light-cone coordinate, which the composition of two acts above light reaches from the cone's own wedge, so that wherever the construction carries a change the content and the breakdown have one address. A computer-algebra transcript shows the replication in the machinery, and the floating-point standard of the hardware carries the four rules as operations: its token for an invalid operation propagates through every operation and is the one kind of datum its equality leaves unpaired with itself, so that Frege's concept has in the hardware one kind of object, in each of its encodings. The paper states what stands when the sign is withdrawn, the base balance, the semigroup of acts with the height as its invariant, the agreement branch with the border recorded, the orientation mark on its regimes with its selection rule, and the velocity as the record of the act, and it draws the consequences: the structure of the derivation belongs to every derivation that clears a relation by a factor and cancels one, the schoolbook extraneous root being its smallest instance, so that a solved formula is to be read against the formation domain of the relation it was solved from, and a mechanical audit of that reading is given and run; every totalization of division is a completion through which the sign re-enters, and the two addresses of the sign in the construction are the two completions performed by the velocity coordinate, so that a coordinate placed on a family of acts is to be audited at its ends; and the content of a construction located at the balance locus of its clearing factor is delivered by classical notation as a record and by the presence grammar as a presentation.
